summary: Tested Team Admin Hub feature - all 13 backend API tests passed, frontend UI fully functional with Overview, Payment Tracker, Availability, and Roster Actions sections working correctly
critical_code_review_comments: TeamAdminHub.js is well-structured with 4 clear sections (Overview, Payment Tracker, Availability, Roster Actions)
Backend payment endpoint correctly updates both teamAssignments and user-level fields for primary team
GET /api/team/{team_id}/players correctly returns payment and availability fields from teamAssignments
CSV export functionality implemented client-side - works correctly for roster, payment report, and emergency contacts
seed_data_creation: None - used existing team eagles_01 with 3 players
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Admin Hub is fully functional. Eagles team has 3 players: Test User Multi-Team (paid, $150), Nick (unpaid), Test Player Eagles (unpaid). Payment and availability updates work correctly via PUT endpoints. Admin Hub tab only appears for users with admin/league_admin/coach roles.

features_verified.admin_hub_tab_visibility: ✅ Tab appears for logged in admin/coach users on team detail page
features_verified.overview_section: ✅ Shows correct player count (3), payment stats (1 paid, 0 partial, 2 unpaid), availability stats (3 active), and collected amount ($150)
features_verified.payment_tracker_section: ✅ Filter buttons (All/Paid/Partial/Unpaid) work, player list shows payment status and Update button
features_verified.payment_update_modal: ✅ Modal shows Payment Status dropdown, Amount Owed, Amount Paid, Last Payment Date, Notes fields with Cancel/Save buttons
features_verified.availability_section: ✅ Filter buttons (All/Active/Injured/On Leave/Inactive) work, each player has availability dropdown
features_verified.roster_actions_section: ✅ Bulk actions (Reset All Payments, Activate All Players), communication tools (Copy All Emails, Copy Unpaid Emails), export buttons (Full Roster CSV, Payment Report CSV, Emergency Contacts CSV)
features_verified.backend_get_players_api: ✅ GET /api/team/{team_id}/players returns payment and availability fields
features_verified.backend_payment_update_api: ✅ PUT /api/team/{team_id}/player/{player_id}/payment correctly updates payment status, amount paid, amount owed
